description: mutt 2.2, patch attached: multipart/mixed: inline text/plain + text/x-diff with a filename (an attachment, never text); the patch contains From , --- and --  lines
raw:
Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 22:14:05 +0100
From: =?iso-8859-2?Q?Ond=F8ej_Bene=B9?= <ondrej@host.example.com>
To: Karel Holub <karel@example.org>
Subject: Patch for the snapshot rotation
Message-ID: <20260311211405.GA23456@host.example.com>
MIME-Version: 1.0
Content-Type: multipart/mixed; boundary="Qx7mB2vQ9c/Z4tR1"
Content-Disposition: inline
User-Agent: Mutt/2.2.13 (2024-03-09)


--Qx7mB2vQ9c/Z4tR1
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=us-ascii
Content-Disposition: inline

Hi Karel,

the attached patch fixes the rotation: the script compared the snapshot
age with ">" instead of ">=", so the oldest snapshot was never removed.

Tested on the staging box, three rotations in a row.

Ondrej

--Qx7mB2vQ9c/Z4tR1
Content-Type: text/x-diff; charset=us-ascii
Content-Disposition: attachment; filename="0001-rotate-remove-oldest-snapshot.patch"

From 3c9e1f2a7b4d5e6f8091a2b3c4d5e6f708192a3b Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Ondrej Benes <ondrej@host.example.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 22:05:41 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] rotate: remove the oldest snapshot

---
 rotate.sh | 2 +-
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/rotate.sh b/rotate.sh
index 4b1c2d3..9e8f7a6 100755
--- a/rotate.sh
+++ b/rotate.sh
@@ -12,7 +12,7 @@ KEEP=14
 
 for snap in "$SNAPDIR"/*; do
     age=$(( (now - $(stat -c %Y "$snap")) / 86400 ))
-    if [ "$age" -gt "$KEEP" ]; then
+    if [ "$age" -ge "$KEEP" ]; then
         rm -rf -- "$snap"
     fi
 done
-- 
2.43.0

--Qx7mB2vQ9c/Z4tR1--
